title: Synthetic Policy for Off-Campus Internship Eligibility
content: To be eligible for an off-campus internship, undergraduate students must maintain a minimum CGPA of 2.5 / 4.0 (or 6.5 / 10.0) and have zero (0) active backlogs across all previous semesters. Students must have completed at least 5 full semesters and earned 100 academic credits.
